newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates jump at close on operation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates jump at close on operation.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates jumped on Wednesday on a weekly open market operation by the State (central) Bank of Pakistan, dealers said.

"Owing to the operation, the market opened with very wide spreads quoted by players," said a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank. "Initial bids were seen at six percent and offers at 16 percent. But most deals were done around 12-13 percent."

Dealers said the players remained skeptical about taking positions before the operation's results. The central bank accepted around 7.0 billion rupees at 16.95 percent outright and the market ended at 20 percent. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
